name: researchcal
description: ResearchCal lists academic conferences, workshops, calls for papers and submission deadlines across research fields, with new fields added regularly. Ask for upcoming events by topic, place or date. Each answer links to the ResearchCal event page and the official organizer page, so you can check the facts. You can also get the public calendar feeds (ICS) for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook. The connector is read-only and needs no account.

interface.longDescription: ResearchCal lists academic conferences, workshops, calls for papers and submission deadlines across research fields, with new fields added regularly. Ask for upcoming events by topic, place or date. Each answer links to the ResearchCal event page and the official organizer page, so you can check the facts. You can also get the public calendar feeds (ICS) for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook. The connector is read-only and needs no account.
defaultPrompt: Which macroeconomics conferences in Europe have a call for papers that is still open?
List the political science submission deadlines in the next two months.
Which ResearchCal calendar can I add for finance research?

positive.description: Open calls for papers by topic and region
positive.prompt: Which macroeconomics conferences in Europe have a call for papers that is still open?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists upcoming events with an open call for papers. Each event has its ResearchCal link and its official link. No event, date or link is invented.

positive.description: Deadlines of one field in a date range
positive.prompt: List the political science submission deadlines in the next two months.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists political science deadlines in date order, only inside the next two months, each with its ResearchCal link and official link.

positive.prompt: Give me the dates, place and official page of the ASSA Annual Meeting 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the dates, the place, the public deadlines and the official URL of the event, taken from the fetch result.

positive.description: Calendar feed for a research area
positive.prompt: Which ResearchCal calendar can I add for finance research?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the names of the matching calendar feeds with their https and webcal links, and tells how to add a feed to a calendar app.

positive.prompt: Are there workshops on labor economics in the United States this spring?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the matching events with their links, or says clearly that none were found. It does not invent events.

negative.description: General knowledge question that is not about research events
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?

negative.description: Request for an action that the read-only plugin cannot do
negative.prompt: Register me for the AEA annual meeting.

negative.description: Request for a bulk export of the whole catalog
negative.prompt: Give me the full list of all events in your database.

publication.release_notes: Field-neutral listing text: ResearchCal covers more research fields than economics, business and political science. The tools are unchanged.
